units.median_ns_per_op: nanoseconds per flush: the benchmark's median over one run's samples
units.walk_flush_ns_per_flush: nanoseconds per flush: summed clock intervals around each flush, divided by flushes
units.walk_empty_clock_ns_per_flush: nanoseconds per flush: summed empty clock intervals, divided by flushes
units.walk_flush_minus_clock_ns_per_flush: nanoseconds per flush: derived, the flush interval minus the empty clock interval
units.paired_change_pct: percent change against the reference variant's run of the same round
